answer: Fake swarms fail when credit must climb a live vine of invoices. An applicant posts 4.40 POA and settles three paid jobs with sponsors in separate clusters; each sponsor locks 2.15 POA of umber-marked escrow for 5 epochs and issues a 17-byte invoice hash chained to the last. The third invoice files only in a 22-minute tide after the pulse at minute 13. Thirty aliases would pin 132 POA of posts plus 193.5 POA of escrow. Graders walk the chain, check cluster diversity, and recompute the pulse window; a repeated sponsor, broken hash, or late filing slashes 48% and benches sponsors for 3 epochs.
